title: Normalized restricted Walsh vector
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $A$ assign to each $\omega\in\Omega$ a sign vector in $\{ -1,1\}^n$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The normalized restricted Walsh vector is the function on $\Omega$ given by $\omega\mapsto |\Omega|^{-1/2}\prod_{i\in S}A(\omega)_i$, regarded as a vector in Euclidean space.
